blurb: Bar Le Sacrilège is an adults-only (18+) neighbourhood bar located at 447 rue Saint-Jean, Quebec City, open daily from noon to 3 a.m. It features a hidden inner courtyard patio that is open-air from May 1 to November 1 and a heated, glass-enclosed winter garden from November 1 to May 1.
extraNote: No cover charge · Groups of 12 or more must reserve by email · Walk-in for groups under 12 · No room fee for group bookings · You can bring your own food for group bookings · No reservation needed for regular visits, first come first served · 447 rue Saint-Jean, Quebec City, in the Saint-Jean-Baptiste neighbourhood, a ~10-minute walk from Porte Saint-Jean (the Old Quebec gate). · Open year-round; patio open-air May 1 to November 1, heated winter garden November 1 to May 1
